messages:
maya: starting a staged canary for runtime-engine kernel v2.3-quant — targeting night change window (02:00-04:00 PT). rolling to canary pool A first. please read the plan below and flag anything risky.
deploybot: preflight checks: images built (v2.3-quant-20260320), signatures ok, infra capacity ok, smoke artifacts present. next action: `/deploy start canary v2.3-quant --pool canary-A --weight 10% --hold 15m`

raj: question — are we pinning the old abi anywhere? we should avoid mixed-abi when traffic ramps.

chen: yep pin TTL recommended. plan: pin kernel:v2.2 for 6h on critical clusters, allow v2.3 only in canary pools. if canary good, unpin and ramp. pin command: `kubectl annotate nodes redwood-rt --overwrite deploy.pin=kernel:v2.2 ttl=6h`

liam: rollout schedule I propose: 10% -> wait 15m -> 30% -> wait 20m -> 60% -> full. abort criteria: p95 latency increase >20% vs baseline OR error-rate >0.5% OR increase in kv-cache eviction >3x. also manual stop if evals show hallucinations on our smoke prompts.

ana: (typo: ana) i can curate a short release notes blurb and the changelog. link to draft: https://docs.internal/release-notes/engine/v2.3-quant-draft.md please add any user-facing items.

maya: adding pipelined smoke tests: run on canary nodes `./scripts/smoke_run.sh --profile quant --seed 42` should produce baseline metrics. post results to this thread.
deploybot: action queued: `/deploy start canary v2.3-quant --pool canary-A --weight 10% --hold 15m` executed by maya at 2734509180. canary instances: 12 pods. health checks passing: 12/12. telemetry subscription enabled.

raj: reminder: set deploy pin TTL on deploybot for the canary so we don't accidentally unpin during auto-rollouts. `deploybot pin set kernel:v2.2 --ttl 6h --scope critical`

chen: hooking in opsbot to monitor kv-cache metrics and p95. opsbot, please watch `rt.latency.p95`, `rt.errors.per_minute`, `kv.cache.evictions` and call this thread if thresholds exceed.

opsbot: monitors set. alerting thresholds: p95 > baseline*1.2, errors/min > 0.5% of requests, kv.cache.evictions > baseline*3. Will report anomalies here.

liam: initial 15m hold complete -> manual check time. summary: p95 +8%, p50 +3%, errors 0.12%, kv-evict ~1.1x. smoke outputs matched on 96/100 prompts, 4 flagged minor formatting diffs. i vote continue to 30%.

maya: agreeing. proceeding to `/deploy ramp v2.3-quant --to 30% --wait 20m` now.
deploybot: ramp executed at 2734509325: now 30% traffic, 36 pods. health: 36/36. will hold 20m.

ana: release notes updated: short blurb + compatibility note about quantized matmul change and guidance to pin if you rely on exact float-level determinism. link updated.

liam: during hold: p95 still +9%, errors 0.15%, kv-evict 1.3x, smoke 95/100. no user-facing regressions in canary logs. continuing to 60% after hold unless someone objects.

raj: no objections. remind infra to keep capacity headroom, we need spare nodes to do quick rollback traffic slices.

maya: ramping to 60% now. if opsbot alerts, we abort and execute rollback playbook: `/deploy rollback v2.2 --scope global` — that will pin v2.2 and shift traffic back. everyone OK with that? :+1:

chen: +1

ana: +1

liam: +1

opsbot: hold — detected kv.cache.evictions spike at 2734509395: 3.8x baseline. p95 trending toward 1.25x. declaring advisory, please validate.

maya: stopping ramp. executing rollback plan. deploybot: `/deploy rollback v2.2 --reason "kv-cache-evictions spike during quant canary"`
deploybot: rollback initiated at 2734509402: traffic shifted back to v2.2 (pinned), canary instances scaled down. starting post-rollback smoke.

liam: post-rollback checks: latency reverted, errors stable, kv-evictions back to baseline. good. filing a postmortem action: investigate quant kernel's cache allocation change and add a telemetry gate to detect evictions sooner.

maya: created checklist ticket RD-3421 to track root cause, heatmap, and smaller repro. also will update release notes to include the rollback and guidance for private deploy customers. thanks all, lesson: add kv-cache eviction to preflight smoke for future quant builds. :handshake:
